payload.claim: Revisit if any of the following happens. (1) The integrity gate escalates: the reported SEC probe becomes formal charges, the board investigation finds disclosure failures touching the reported figures, or a restatement occurs. (2) Receivables, guarantee exposure or long-term debt keep growing faster than revenue in the Q4 FY2027 report, or DSO rises further on extended payment terms. (3) Q4 FY2027 revenue falls short of the $130.0bn plus or minus 3% guide, gross margin lands below the 71.0-72.0% range, or the roughly 75% FY2028 growth outlook is cut. (4) A permanent CEO and a separate CFO are named and the board investigation closes without findings against the accounts. (5) The code-computed margin of safety turns positive across both measured discount rates on updated owner earnings.

prediction.reasoning: Management's raised FY2028 outlook of about 75% must be achieved against a FY2027 base inflated by a 14th week, with weekly growth only about 4% above Q3, and with demand increasingly supported by NVIDIA's own receivables, guarantees and equity stakes; I expect that financing-dependence and the tighter export regime to leave growth short of the outlook. Even so, growth near that level would far exceed the 35.1% the price requires on average, so my disagreement with the market is about how durable growth is beyond FY2028, not about next year.
